# Original DSH path discovery

Public [deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/tree/d743267388641bc76f17c45ce8b4c231aed1d32c), commit d743267388641bc76f17c45ce8b4c231aed1d32c, supplies the four selected modules under its preserved [MIT licence](LICENSE). SOURCE.json records both upstream and selected hashes. Search and grammar change local NodeNext module imports only; static guidance is extracted unchanged from the supplier seam, excluding its Cordis service. Types are verbatim. Search, ranking, exclusions, bounds, cancellation and stale-index behaviour remain original.

These modules discover paths only. They read directory metadata; choosing a path does not read file contents or attach a file. The model must use its effective filesystem tool before claiming to have read it. The Pi adapter scopes searches to authorized Desktop session workspaces and exposes no discovery to read-only inspectors or browser-only/delegated conversations. No supplier Host or second agent loop is mounted.
